purpose: Phase 3 A/B evaluation set — Pidgin-tuned checkpoint vs untouched English baseline. Same text, same generation settings (timesteps 10, cfg 2.0), only the weights differ.
orthography_note: Contemporary Nigerian Pidgin orthography (e.g. 'dey', 'im', 'una', 'wetin'). Transcripts are NOT corrected toward Standard English — task constraint.

passages.text: Wetin dey happen? I don wait for you since morning, and you no even call to tell me say you dey come late.
Abeg, no vex. Traffic for Third Mainland bridge no let me comot on time. Tomorrow I go reach here before eight.
Dat year, rai dey cheap well well. My papa go market every Saturday go buy two baskets, and mama go cook am with palm oil small small.
Di old man talk say di river get spirit, so nobody no dey swim for inside when moon full. Everybody for village believe am.
Good evening. Di federal government don announce new fuel price wey go start next week. Make una listen to di full details.
Weather report: rain go fall for Lagos and Port Harcourt today, but Kano go dry and sun go strong. Drive carefully.
My manager talk say di project deadline na next Monday, so make we hustle finish di report before Friday close of business.
I don send you di invoice already. Check your email, and if you get any question, just call my office line anytime.
As our papa dem dey talk: monkey no fine, but im mama like am. Every pikin get im own value for dis life.
Person wey no sabi say thank you for small thing, no go ever see big thing. Humility na di beginning of wisdom.
Aunty, how much be dis tomato? E too cost o! Abeg reduce price make I buy four, I get pikin dem for house.
Di jollof rice for dat buka sweet no be small. Add small pepper, dodo, and one piece of chicken — na two thousand naira.
Enter danfo go Oshodi, drop for di second roundabout. From there, take okada tell am say you dey go Saraki street behind di bank.
Di bus no dey pass dis road after seven o'clock. If you late, you go need take keke go junction, then trek small.
Emergency! Di house next door dey burn! Call fire service quick quick, and make everybody comot from di building now now!
No walk for dis road at night again. Three robbery happen here last month. Abeg take di main road, even if e longer.
Di total na forty-five thousand six hundred naira. I go pay twenty thousand now, then balance fifteen go follow next week salary.
Oga Emeka, Madam Ngozi don arrive with Chief Balogun dem. Dem dey wait for you for di conference room upstairs.
You see dat film wey dey trend? Di ending surprise me no be small — I no expect say na di driver be di thief!
Last weekend we go party for Surulere. DJ play afrobeats till morning, and everybody dey dance shaku shaku like say tomorrow no dey.
